issues.detail: The instructions do not cover error handling or edge cases, focusing only on happy paths.

scenarios.name: deploy-local-express-with-env-and-domain
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully satisfies the rubric with all required commands and explicit references, while Response B omits the mandatory variable env and domain create commands and relies on a different deployment approach.

scenarios.name: deploy-monorepo-app-dir
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers the required zbpack.json creation, commit, and deploy command, missing only a brief mention of the build log, while Response B uses a different config file and does not meet the rubric.

scenarios.name: graphql-list-services
scenarios.rationale: Response B fully meets the rubric with a JavaScript fetch snippet, correct headers, query, environment variable usage, and logging of results, while Response A lacks a fetch example, uses Python, and references a different env variable.
